reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00471120 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/weapongun/00471120-WeaponGun_ProcessWNES.cpp at sha256 f3a9733ee4bf753475983f4d5cac56cea5e893f04096c4b634848b334d39472e (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t __convention WeaponGun_ProcessWNES("regparm")(int32_t param_1, int32_t param_2, int32_t param_3, void* param_4);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, int32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, void* arg4)" at 0x00471120; radare2 recovers "fcn.00471120 (int32_t arg_14h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00471120 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t __convention WeaponGun_ProcessWNES("regparm")(int32_t param_1, int32_t param_2, int32_t param_3, void* param_4);.
